title: Convex Optimization of Spiking Neural Networks with Global and Approximation Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2605.08022v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) have been proposed as energy-efficient alternatives to deep neural networks. Their training is non-convex and involves a non-differentiable spike function, so existing methods offer no guarantee of reaching a global optimum. We address this issue by formulating SNN optimization as an equivalent convex optimization problem. Specifically, we show that the weight-decay-regularized training problem for a class of threshold RNNs, including leaky integrate-and-fire SNNs, has zero duality gap and the same optimal value as a convex program. Since the resulting convex programs can have exponentially many variables in the amount of data, we introduce a practical randomized surrogate and establish a high-probability guarantee on its approximation quality. translated_title: 具有全局最优与近似保证的脉冲神经网络凸优化
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络已被提出作为深度神经网络的节能替代方案。其训练问题是非凸的，且涉及不可微的脉冲函数，因此现有方法无法保证达到全局最优。我们通过将脉冲神经网络优化问题表述为一个等价的凸优化问题来解决这一难题。具体而言，我们证明了一类阈值循环神经网络（包括泄漏积分发放型脉冲神经网络）在带权重衰减正则化条件下的训练问题具有零对偶间隙，且与某个凸规划具有相同的最优值。由于所得的凸规划的变量数量可能随数据量呈指数级增长，我们进一步引入了一种实用的随机化替代方法，并为其近似质量建立了高概率保证。从实证结果来看，表现最好的凸优化变体在加法（addition）和首尾XOR（first-last-XOR）任务上优于代理梯度训练方法，在序列MNIST任务上与其性能相当。
tldr: 该论文将脉冲神经网络（包括LIF-SNN）的训练问题首次等价转化为凸优化问题，证明了零对偶间隙与全局最优保证，并提出具有高概率近似保证的随机化替代方法以解决凸规划变量指数级增长的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates spiking neural network training (including LIF-SNNs) as an equivalent convex optimization problem with zero duality gap and global optimality guarantees, and introduces a practical randomized surrogate with high-probability approximation guarantees to handle the exponentially many variables.
